title: Standardization and Goulash Socialism in the 20th Century
grammar: Sensory similes in critique and culinary nostalgia (mintha elveszett volna)
goal: I can explain the postwar nationalization of restaurants, uniform recipe books, and the era of 'Goulash Socialism'.
I can use sensory similes and evaluative comparison clauses with mintha to analyze food quality and culinary history.
I can evaluate the 1958 Brussels World Expo Hungarian pavilion (Somlói galuska, Hortobágyi palacsinta) and state-directed catering.
